SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.net_revenue_eur), 2)
FROM (
  -- one row per physical store with a 2025 order
  SELECT o.store_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_type <> 'web'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
) AS t
